cacheWriteBilling.title: Swap cache write prices
cacheWriteBilling.description: When enabled, swap the 5-minute and 1-hour write prices. When disabled, bill the actual duration normally. Actual durations and usage stay unchanged. Applies to new requests after saving.
cacheWriteBilling.basePriceHint: Each duration uses its specific price, falling back to the base price. The cache price switch swaps these rates.

cacheWriteBilling.historical: Actual write {{actual}}; historical billing duration evidence was not recorded
cacheWriteBilling.missingCostItem: Actual write {{actual}}; this record has no cache cost item for that duration, so its billing basis is unknown.

cacheWriteBilling.effectiveRule: Billed at the {{duration}} rate after swapping
